recentItems.title: A Chinese town transformed by east-west poverty alleviation collaboration
recentItems.description:
Over three decades, Minning, a town in China's Ningxia, has transformed from an impoverished settlement on the edge of the Gobi Desert into a productive town.
Minning is just one of the many beneficiaries of China's east-west collaboration for poverty alleviation, which pairs developed eastern provinces with less-developed western regions to share resources, expertise and investment.

recentItems.title: Indian expert: BRICS gives the Global South a bigger voice
recentItems.description: The Global South is growing, but its voice in global rule-making remains limited. Indian economist says BRICS could help change that, with cooperation spanning AI, energy, critical minerals and supply chains.

recentItems.title: From harsh land to thriving town: The power of east-west pairing assistance
recentItems.description:
What changes can east-west pairing assistance bring?
For Minning, it helped transform a once-impoverished region into a thriving town.
Since 1996, Fujian in east China has partnered with Ningxia in the northwest, bringing technology, investment and expertise, and creating new opportunities for local communities.
From mushroom farming to winemaking, intelligent manufacturing and green energy, Minning is now a showcase of what regional cooperation can achieve.
